reviews.name: Dr. Rohit Saxena
reviews.content: GLOBAL Institute is truly the benchmark for spoken English and personality grooming. Coach Faizan Khan's personal attention to every student's individual weakness is remarkable. My public presentation skills and patient consultations have improved dramatically.

reviews.name: Sneha Mukherjee
reviews.content: I joined with severe hesitation. After just 4 weeks of daily jam sessions, extempore, and vocabulary drills, I gave my TCS interview in pure English without a single stutter. Selected in round 1! Thank you Coach Faizan sir!

reviews.name: Mohammad Tariq
reviews.content: The 12-level curriculum is scientifically designed. You don't have to cram boring grammar formulas. The practical speaking atmosphere forces you to think in English. Recommended to every teacher and student.

reviews.name: Priyanka Mehra
reviews.content: The transformation in my body language, voice modulation, and stage confidence is unbelievable. The mock podium sessions gave me the courage to host corporate town halls. Best decision of my life!

reviews.name: Amitabh Joshi
reviews.content: The mock interviews conducted by Coach Faizan Khan reflect real corporate panel standards. The video analysis showed me how many times I was using filler words. Today I hold two MNC offers!

reviews.name: Kavita Choudhary
reviews.content: Friendly trainers, positive environment, and daily speaking opportunities. Within 60 days, I lost my stage fright completely and now handle premium HDFC corporate clientele with ease.
